bounded_checks.findings: Model correction: the shared spatial_epigenome construct placed revcomp(linker 1) directly against genomic DNA and omitted the Tn5ME-A transferred strand. Linker 1 is computed to be the exact splint of the barcode-A 3' mosaic end and the 15-nt Tn5ME-A 5' extension, so the read strand carries barcode-A ME + CATCGGCGTACGACT + Tn5ME-A ME before gDNA; Read 1 genomic start corrected from cycle 81 to 100 (barcode B 1–8, A 39–46 unchanged). Construct now built locally from Deng 2022 values (no longer Farzad-sourced), adding fixation/permeabilization, EDTA stop, T4 ligase conditions, proteinase K reversal, Zymo DCC-5 cleanup, exact New-P5-SMART/Ad2 PCR geometry with 72C gap fill and qPCR-determined cycles, 1x AMPure cleanup, unresolved same-adapter candidate products and exact oligo input states. Published discrepancy displayed: Deng 2022 Methods Tn5ME-A CATCGGCGTACGACT-ME vs Farzad 2024 Supp Table 1 TCGTCGGCAGCGTC-ME (Steps 16–24); model uses 2022, linker 1 pairs only with it.
